## Changed
- Rebalanced both War Axe variants toward a slower, heavier "commit to the swing" playstyle — bigger per-hit damage, less spammy.
  - **Lonsdaleite War Axe** — attack damage `13 → 16`, attack speed `-3.9 → -3.6` (full-charge recharge `10.0s → 2.5s`).
  - **Perfect Lonsdaleite War Axe** — attack damage `18 → 20`, attack speed `-3.7 → -3.5` (full-charge recharge `3.3s → 2.0s`).
  - The old `-3.9` speed left the base tier with a ~10-second recharge between fully-charged hits, which was unusable even for a heavy weapon. Both tiers now sit in a playable heavy-hitter range while keeping their burst-over-sustained identity — the Perfect War Axe matches netherite-axe sustained DPS delivered in double-size hits, and stays fair against netherite-tier armor.

All other stats (durability, mining behavior, enchantability, sword/axe enchant compatibility) are unchanged.
